findingResolution.resolution: Rule R7 admits every required member of DLV CoverageKeyV1, of C-2 coverageKey.key, and of the returned CoverageKeyV2, and ViewEntryV3.relation and ViewEntryV3.resolution, only where R1 to R6 do not. L-C1 --check exits 0. The derived ceiling has those constituents and no others: 33 R7 paths, all relation, resolution, or schemaVersion.
The opening paragraph states the four delta-round triggers as Review and effect states them, including which FA-2 and RUST3-LIM parts need none.

o7: a delta round only if the outcome lets a provider execute repository code, needs a new wire signal or member for confinement, or makes the provider resident or pooled
sm: item 9, every placeholder, F, T, and every outcome, including SM-11 to SM-14 as measured figures
O3 and O4, including both when (B) and (C) hold together
a TS2 limit question that only a successor can answer, through SM-6
MC's conditional S-R, through SM-5 and SM-6
fa2: item 10's census sentence, which follows item 22
a delta round for any forced change to a wire member, a key's commitment (including every FA-2 §0 row, A to D), the admission point, or the reuse treatment
none for FA-2's NE:93 header sentence, schema layout, vectors, evidence, README prose, or materialization map
rust3lim: items 1 and 13 (its row, and the AnalyzeV2 row's condition)

a delta round for any later change to a part that sets a wire member or a commitment, including a rebuild forced through FA-2's handshake copies (its token, §0 rows E and F, §9.3a and its §9.2 and §9.6 overrides, the subject-scope schema)
none for its README prose, evidence, vectors, scratch verify, or materialization map
NBO-1 needs none; NBO-2 reopens L only if it is closed by editing §9.3a's reading rule
